DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0631] config | dlq.max_connections | version 4.x
# `dlq.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `64` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | connections |

## Notes

Changes to `dlq.max_connections` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_connections = 64
```

---

[d0385] config | coordinator.max_connections | version 4.x
# `coordinator.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `4096` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | connections |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
max_connections = 4096
```

---

# `replicator.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |

| Type | integer |

| Component | replicator |
| Unit | connections |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

[d0258] config | retention.max_connections | version 4.x
# `retention.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `512` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | connections |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.max_connections` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
max_connections = 512
```
